kits.name: Give an apple
kits.description: One apple: something to press on a new server, and the smallest example of a catalog entry.

kits.name: Healing Potions I
kits.description: 5 Lesser Health Potions. Each heals 30% of your health: 15% at once and 15% over 5 seconds. Brewed at a tier 1 Alchemy bench.

kits.name: Healing Potions II
kits.description: 5 Small Health Potions. Each heals 45% of your health: 15% at once and 30% over 5 seconds. Brewed at a tier 2 Alchemy bench.

kits.name: Healing Potions III
kits.description: 5 Health Potions. Each heals 60% of your health: 25% at once and 35% over 5 seconds. Brewed at a tier 3 Alchemy bench.

kits.name: Healing Potions IV
kits.description: 5 Greater Health Potions. Each heals 75% of your health: 25% at once and 50% over 5 seconds. Brewed at a tier 4 Alchemy bench.

kits.name: Camp Rations
kits.description: Campfire food (the game's first food tier): cooked meat, grilled fish and roast vegetables. Each heals a little at once, then a short health regeneration.

kits.name: Cook's Basket
kits.description: Cooking bench food (the second food tier): bread, skewers and salad, with a longer, stronger regeneration than campfire food.

kits.name: Feast Hamper
kits.description: The game's best food (the third food tier): pies and Caesar salad, with the longest regeneration.
